segments.text: Many of us are not Enemies to sin, and how then are we reconciled to God? what, friends with God, and our Lusts too? it cannot be. Psal. 97. 10. Ye that love the Lord hate evil: the same hour our reconciliation is made with God, there is an everlasting breach made with sin: this is one of the Articles or Conditions of our peace with God, Isai. 55. 7. Let the wicked forsake his ways, and the unrighteous man his thoughts, and let him turn to the Lord, and he will have mercy on him; and to our God, and he will abundantly pardon.

But it's manifest in many of us that we are no enemies to sin, we secretly indulge it, what bad names soever we call it by: we will commit ten sins to cover one: we cannot endure the most serious faithful, seasonable, private, tender, and necessary reproofs of Sin, but our hearts swell and rise at it: sure we are not reconciled to God, whilest we embrace sin his enemy in our bofoms.
